name: view_duskmoth_hovers_and_flaps
description: The Duskmoth flies (design 2.4): it hovers about a metre over the road and bobs, shots and its health bar find it in the air, its 'walk' is its flap and runs at its flight speed over its stride, and slowed hard it still beats its wings, never slower than the slowest flap. It carries no light: its glow is its model's emission. A Gourdling beside it keeps to the ground, and the Bristlesow walks at its own stride.

steps.assert: m.kind == 'duskmoth' and m.winged and g.kind == 'gourdling' and b.kind == 'bristlesow'
steps.msg: a Duskmoth, a Gourdling and the Bristlesow on the road
the moth hovers about a metre over the road, within its bob

steps.assert: m.aim_point().y - m.global_position.y > 1.0 and m._bar_root.position.y > 1.2 and m._rune.position.y > 1.2
steps.msg: shots, its health bar and a mark find it in the air

steps.assert: g.hover == 0.0 and g.aim_point().y - g.global_position.y < 0.7 and absf(g._body.position.y) < 0.05
steps.msg: the Gourdling keeps to the ground

steps.assert: m._anim != null and m._anim.current_animation == 'walk' and absf(m._anim.speed_scale - m.pace / 1.5) < 0.001
steps.msg: the moth flaps at its flight speed over its stride (1.5: three flaps a second)
the flap runs with the simulation's ticks
slowed 90% it still beats its wings, at the slowest flap

steps.assert: m.find_children('*', 'Light3D', true, false).is_empty() and scene.find_children('*', 'Light3D', true, false).size() == lights
steps.msg: it carries no light and the scene gains none: its glow is its model's emission
the Bristlesow, a Thornback twice its size, walks at its own stride
